setup.title: MDVR Camera Setup
setup.stepServer: Point the device at the server (A21)
setup.a21Help: This command binds the device to the platform. Reboot the device afterwards. The same values work over SMS.
setup.testHelp: After starting, wait a few seconds for the device to push RTMP; HLS starts as soon as MediaMTX has a playlist.
setup.helpCodec: The device codec must be H.264 (not H.265), with live streaming and the camera channel enabled.
setup.helpSmsCommands:
A21,1,<IP>,5023,<APN>,,      ← server config
D11                        ← device status
A10,0                      ← one-shot position
setup.helpPorts: 5023 (device GPRS) and 1935 (RTMP push) must be forwarded to this server from the internet.

wizard.title: Device Config Wizard (TCP)
wizard.deviceHelp: Every setting in this wizard is delivered over the device's TCP connection (port 5023). If the device is not connected yet, send A21 via SMS first (see the help in the test step).

import.subtitle: Upload an Excel or CSV file. Download the template so the columns match.
import.dropHint: Accepts .xlsx and .csv. Store IMEI and code columns as Text in Excel.

hints.vehicles: Required columns: name, code, fleetCode. If that fleet does not exist yet, it is created from fleetCode (e.g. FLEET-01). Optional: plate, vin, odometerKm (current km), engineHours (hour meter).
hints.devices: Required: imei (15 digits, Luhn-valid) and protocol (meitrack, gt06, jt808, or stub). Optional: serialNumber, manufacturer, model, vehicleCode (binds after create).
hints.drivers: Required: firstName, lastName, licenseNumber. Optional: employeeId, email, phone, licenseClass, licenseIssued, licenseExpires (YYYY-MM-DD), licenseCountry, vehicleCode (assigns after create).

reports.title: Reports & Analytics
reports.subtitle: Fleet performance based on real telemetry
reports.empty: No data for the selected range.

utilization.note: Utilization = moving / observed telemetry time (see KPI definitions). “—” means no telemetry in range — not zero.

geofence.note: Counts come from the geofence event pipeline; time inside is summed from EXIT occupancies.

odometer.note: End reading is the registry odometer. Start is estimated as end minus trip distance in the selected range.

analytics.kpiNote: Each indicator is the documented backend KPI. The chip is the change versus the immediately previous window of the same length (not a target).
